promptText: Which soft brand or collection hotel brands should an owner consider for affiliation in North America while preserving the hotel’s individuality?
rawText:
An owner in North America who wants to **preserve the hotel’s individuality** should mainly evaluate **soft brands / collections** that let a property keep its own name, design, and local character while plugging into a larger company’s sales, reservations, and loyalty systems.[1][2][12]

The most commonly cited options are:

| Parent company | Soft brand / collection | Best fit |
|---|---|---|
| **Marriott** | **Autograph Collection**, **Tribute Portfolio**, **The Luxury Collection** | Independent hotels that want broad distribution and strong loyalty access while keeping a distinctive identity.[4][6][18] |
| **Hilton** | **Curio Collection**, **Tapestry Collection**, **LXR Hotels & Resorts** | Properties seeking a more flexible affiliation with Hilton’s marketing and loyalty engine.[4][6][19] |
| **Hyatt** | **The Unbound Collection**, **Destination by Hyatt**, **JdV by Hyatt** | Owners who want a softer flag and a curated, independent feel.[4][11] |
| **Wyndham** | **Trademark Collection**, **Registry Collection Hotels** | Independent, upper-upscale to luxury properties that want to remain distinctive; Trademark is specifically described as geared to owners who want to uphold their independent spirit.[9][11] |
| **Choice** | **Ascend Hotel Collection** | One of the earliest soft brands, aimed at upscale boutique and historic hotels with fewer fixed standards.[14][15] |
| **Sonesta** | **MOD Collection** | Designed for owners seeking to preserve a hotel’s individuality, personality, and local connection.[8] |

If you want the short answer on **which to consider first in North America**, the most established and widely referenced soft-brand collections are **Marriott’s Autograph Collection**, **Hilton’s Curio Collection**, **Hyatt’s Unbound Collection / Destination by Hyatt**, **Wyndham’s Trademark Collection**, and **Choice’s Ascend Hotel Collection**.[4][6][9][11][14][15]

A practical way to choose among them is:
- **Luxury / upper-upscale independent hotels:** Marriott **The Luxury Collection**, Hilton **LXR**, Hyatt **Unbound**, Wyndham **Registry**.[4][6][11]
- **Lifestyle / boutique hotels:** Marriott **Autograph**, Hilton **Curio** or **Tapestry**, Hyatt **JdV**, Wyndham **Trademark**.[4][6][9][11]
- **Historic, local, or one-of-a-kind assets:** **Ascend**, **Autograph**, **Curio**, **MOD Collection**.[8][14][15]

If you want, I can narrow this to the **best soft brands by segment** (luxury, upper-upscale, lifestyle, historic, resort) or by **owner priorities** such as fees, standards, and loyalty-program strength.
